flavor.description: Equipment: Plate armor, shield, longsword, holy symbol.

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of Protection
additionalAbilities.description: While Glen is not Incapacitated, he and allies within 10 ft. add +4 to saving throws. Benefits from multiple Auras of Protection do not stack.

additionalAbilities.name: Auras of Devotion and Courage
additionalAbilities.description: While within Glen's Aura of Protection, Glen and his allies are immune to Charmed and Frightened.

additionalAbilities.name: Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description: Charisma spellcasting: save DC 17, +9 to hit. Spell slots: four 1st-level, three 2nd-level, three 3rd-level, two 4th-level. Selected spells: Cure Wounds and Divine Smite. Expended slots return after a Long Rest.

additionalAbilities.name: Sacred Weapon
additionalAbilities.description:
As part of the Attack action, Glen can spend one Channel Divinity use to imbue his longsword for 10 minutes, adding +4 to its attack rolls. Each hit can deal its normal damage type or radiant damage. The weapon emits Bright Light for 20 ft. and Dim Light for 20 ft. farther. Glen has three Channel Divinity uses, regaining one after a Short Rest and all after a Long Rest.
